title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (railsorder) — review required
description: In railsorder, .orders*([^)]*params mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via an allowlisted column map.
applicability: railsorder data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
